_comment: Shared automation timeline for the landing-page hero video, applied on top of the 'Vox' factory preset over the male-vocal dry loop at 90 BPM. tools/RenderHero.cpp plays it through the real DSP to produce the audio; tools/record-hero.mjs plays the same timeline into the standalone WebView UI while recording, so every knob move on screen is exactly what you hear. sliders: [t, normalisedValue] breakpoints, linearly interpolated. toggles/combos: [t, value] step events. Story: vocal slaps on one head with the auto-wah filter breathing -> gentle feedback swell -> heads B and C punch in -> plate flips route Post -> In Feedback (tail blooms, stays tasteful) -> a little wow warble -> a short freeze catches the last phrase as a pad -> release, everything returns so the loop closes. Feedback never leaves the musical zone.
